name: Wand of Ith
description: An artifact created by Lord Ith, stolen and used by Mairsil to drain Primata Delphine's magical defenses.

description_citations.text: "Throne of Eldraine (artifact)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil usurps his teacher Ith's position and steals the Wand of Ith.
timeline.quote: When Mairsil usurped his teacher's position, he stole the wand and used it for himself.

timeline.summary: Mairsil uses the wand to drain Primata Delphine's defenses and stabs her to death during her assault on the Conclave.
timeline.quote: draining away her magical defenses and then stabbing her to death

timeline.summary: Delphine leads an assault on the Conclave of Mages and is killed by Mairsil with the Wand of Ith.
timeline.quote: Mairsil drained all of Delphine's magical defenses, and then stabbed her in the chest, killing her

timeline.quote: he drained her wards with the Wand of Ith and then stabbed her to death, setting fire to her corpse.
